questions.text:
Okay. Phone's in my hands. Here goes.
Every night after ten his phone buzzes, and he takes it out to the porch grinning like a teenager.
He hasn't grinned like that in nine years.
Who is he texting every night after ten?

Never heard that name come out of his mouth.
He used to call me every night to complain about the Twins bullpen. Now I'm the one calling, and he's 'busy'. 😔
How many times has he seen her over the past 30 days?

He used to take Mom to places like that, back when they still went out.
Bee has to be short for something, and I'm not meeting this woman without knowing who she is.
What's Bee's last name?

Oh. Mom and Dad used to slow dance to that in the kitchen. I'd pretend to gag. 🥲
Two months ago he was still the same old Dad. Something flipped right around then.
At which event did he and Bee meet?
questions.hint: Look at his WhatsApp, then his Calendar.

questions.text:
I wasn't even there that day. I was working a double. And Tommy never said a word. 💔
A few days ago Dad told me he was going fishing alone, just him and the bobbers.
Where did he really go fishing?

We had a cabin on that lake when I was a kid. Mom taught me to swim off that dock.
And this is the man who told me money's too tight for our Duluth trip this year.
How much money has he put aside?

He's sixty-two and he's known her for two months. 😳
You don't fill one of those out for fun, and around here that means the courthouse. They're actually doing this.
When are they going to the courthouse to get married?

onboarding.text: I'm Lena. ER nurse, mostly nights. I've seen everything come through those doors and I don't scare easy. But my dad has been acting like a teenager for two months, and it's keeping me up.
onboarding.label: Lena

onboarding.text: Dad and I have been a team since Mom walked out nine years ago. Sunday pierogi, Twins on the radio, him still calling me 'kiddo' at thirty-one. He's my person, always has been.
onboarding.label: Lena & Frank

onboarding.text: Frank Ostrowski. Sixty-two, retired machinist, can fix anything except a conversation about feelings. Lately it's cologne, texts after ten, and leaving dinner early with this little smile he thinks I don't notice.
onboarding.label: Frank

onboarding.text: Tonight he forgot his phone on my counter and went to my brother Tommy's to watch the game. I've got a few hours. Help me find out who she is before he gets hurt.
onboarding.label: Lena

msgs.text: Dad did you take your pill today
Yes kiddo, with the coffee like always. You worry too much. Go to sleep.
Bed. 12 hours of other people's problems tonight.
Dinner at mine tomorrow? Pierogi. Potato and cheese, I made forty.
Forty? Dad. We're three people.
Tommy eats like six.
True. I'll bring the pickles.
Your driveway get plowed? It was a rink when I left.
Marty Eide came over and we got the snowblower going. Leave the salt by the door, I'll put it down in the morning. Be careful on those steps kiddo.
I'll be careful. I am a professional at falling on ice.
Thanks for the soup. Left it in the fridge at work and somebody stole half. Savages.
Tell them Frank Ostrowski's soup is not free.
Name and shame.
Lena, your car making that noise again? I can look at it, or bring it by Pete's Auto and tell Pete I sent you. He'll do it for cost.
Brake pads. Already booked. Next week.
Good. Brakes are not where you save.
Twins opener tomorrow. You set?
Radio's warmed up and so am I.
It's 34 degrees.
Perfect baseball weather.
Found your old pink bike in the garage. Do you want it or do I scrap it.
Don't you dare scrap it.
It's rusted into a pretzel.
Then it's a pretzel I'm keeping.
Tommy says he's almost done with his classes. We should do something.
Already thinking about it. Dinner at mine once he's walked. Pierogi, and a real cake from the bakery, not the grocery store kind.
Cake, yes.
Back from nights. 7 in a row. Don't call me until noon unless something is on fire.
Nothing on fire. Sleep kiddo.
Joyce next door gave me a whole tray of bars again, lemon this time. I can't eat all those. Come get some. Bring a bag.
Bars: yes. Judgment: also yes.
Judgment about what
Joyce. Obviously.
My landlord raised the rent again. 😤
How much? If you need help you ask me, I mean it.
I'm good. Just venting. I'm fine.
You're my kid. Venting is allowed.
Went to the cemetery this morning with flowers for Babcia. Put one down for Pop too.
Thanks Dad. Wish I could have come.
You were asleep. You earned it.
Can't make Tommy's thing tomorrow, I picked up a double. Tell him I owe him a beer.
I'll tell him kiddo. He understands. You're saving lives, he'll live. Don't feel bad, I'll take pictures.
Take LOTS of pictures. No thumb over the lens.
That was one time.
How was it? Any pics?
Good party, nice crowd. Tommy looked sharp. I'll send pictures when I figure out how.
Dinner today? I'll do kielbasa.
Sorry, short staffed, I'm working.
Next one then.
Dad, you smell like a department store.
It's cologne kiddo. A man can't buy cologne?
A man can. A man who hasn't in nine years, though.
Don't go looking into it.
Kiddo, about the Duluth trip to Kasia's this year. I'm going to have to skip it. Money's tight this year. I'm sorry. Take her pierogi and tell her I'll call.
Money's tight? You have your pension. You okay?
I'm okay. It's just tight. Don't worry.
Dad. If you need—
I don't. I'm fine.
Okay. 😔
Furnace guy coming for a tune-up. Don't ask why in July. He had an opening.
12 hours down. Home. You alive?
Alive. Twins won last night. You missed it.
Dinner at mine on the 29th? I'll make the chicken.
I'm off. I'll be there. I'll bring the pickles.
What was the something, Dad?
Nothing important. Another time.
Dad.
Another time kiddo. I promise.
Heading up north to fish tomorrow. Just me and the bobbers.
Catch something big.
I'll catch nothing and enjoy it.
Kiddo, can I ask you a favor sometime? Not now. Soon.
Sure. Everything okay?
Everything's good. More than good. Soon.
You're being weird.
I'm sixty-two. I'm allowed.
Dinner at mine tonight? I'm off until tomorrow night. I'll order Pizza Luce.
I'll bring leftover pierogi. Tommy has the game on later so I'll head over there after.
Fine. Don't be late. 😤
Home safe. Thank you for the coffee today. I haven't laughed like that in a long time.
Me too Bee. I about spilled it on my shirt when you did the impression of the dentist guy.
Dr. Pell would be proud 😂
Goodnight. Sleep good.
Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Long day. Three crowns and a man who swore he flosses. He does not floss.
How can you tell
Frank. I can always tell.
Ha. I flossed today in your honor.
Good boy 😄
Twins lost again. Bullpen gave it away in the eighth. Same story.
You're still listening on the radio?
Always. Nothing beats the Twins on the radio with the window open.
Rosie's was a good call. I'm still full from that pie.
Told you. Best pie on the East Side. Don't tell Joyce, she thinks hers is.
My lips are sealed. Goodnight 🌙
Bee I was thinking about that soup you said you make, the one with the dill and the potatoes. Can you send me how you do it, I'd like to try it this weekend. Okay that's all. Bye.
Ha, you're allowed to type, you know 😄 Dill, potatoes, carrots, a little sour cream at the end. I'll write it out properly tomorrow.
Typing is hard. My thumbs are too big.
Made you something. Open Spotify. Track one is where it starts.
Got it. Track one. Bee. I had to sit down.
I hoped you'd say that.
I've played it four times already. Dishes are getting done slow tonight.
Supper club never disappoints. That old fashioned was dangerous.
I was your driver and you still stole half my fries.
Borrowed. I'll pay you back with dessert next time.
Deal. Goodnight Bee.
Joyce brought bars over again. Lemon. Then asked me to look at her mower. That woman has a mower problem every two weeks.
Maybe she has a Frank problem 😏
She's seventy-two!
Doesn't mean she can't have eyes.
You're terrible.
Goodnight 🌙
Gail sends her hello. She says I've been humming at work. I said I haven't. She recorded me.
What were you humming?
A secret.
I hum at my sink too. Don't tell anybody.
Your secret's safe. Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Walleye was perfect tonight.
Mine too. They put too much butter on it but I'm not complaining.
You never complain about butter.
A man has principles.
Fireworks started already. Scared the dog next door half to death.
I like sparklers better. Small and polite.
Sparklers I can respect.
Do you ever feel like a teenager again? Waiting for your phone to buzz?
Every night after ten, Bee.
Me too 🙂
Bee I went by Midway Hardware today and Walt asked why I was whistling. I said I wasn't. Anyway. Goodnight.
What were you whistling?
Can't remember. Probably yours.
Thank you for tonight. I didn't want it to end.
Me neither. The band was good. Slow numbers.
You stepped on my foot exactly once.
Twice. I counted.
Fixed Marty's snowblower in July. Don't ask why. He wants it ready early.
Early bird.
He's an old man. Doesn't trust the weather.
Tough night at work. A patient cried in the chair. I held her hand through the whole cleaning.
That sounds like you.
Thank you Frank. I needed that today.
Twins won! Walk-off. I yelled so loud Joyce flicked her porch light on.
I heard it on the radio at the sink. I may have yelled too.
Now you're a fan.
Don't tell anyone. I'm a closet fan.
Home. My feet hurt from dancing and I regret nothing.
I'm icing my knee. No regrets here either.
Old man.
Old lady.
I will accept 'young lady' only.
Young lady. Goodnight.
That was the nicest night in a long time.
They played that old slow one again.
I noticed 🙂 Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Picking up groceries for the weekend. Do you like rye bread or is that a lie you tell?
Rye. With caraway. Not the light stuff.
Noted. Goodnight 🌙
Long morning. That soup at Kellogg Street Cafe was worth the wait though.
Best soup of the year. I'm still full.
You were so quiet today.
Nervous. Good nervous.
Me too. Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Dinner tonight went sideways. I'll tell you about it tomorrow. Goodnight Bee.
Oh Frank. Whatever it was, you'll find the words. Goodnight 🌙
Thank you for this morning. The mugs, the quiet, the sunrise. I don't think I'll forget it.
Nobody around for a mile. Even the loons kept it down.
Did you catch anything?
One walleye. I let it go. It looked at me funny.
Smart fish. Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Sent a text I've been putting off for a week. Feel sick.
You'll feel better now that it's out of your hands. Breathe. Goodnight 🌙
That corner booth gets me every time.
Same time next week if you'll have me.
Always. Goodnight Frankie 🌙
Fr. Wojcik called me back. He said yes 🙏
Same church, same altar. September 12 at 2. Sending you the pin.
Got it. Saved it on my map. I could find it with my eyes closed.
Me neither, I mean me too. I won't sleep tonight, Frank.
Goodnight Bee. I'm watching the game at Tommy's tomorrow, I'll text you from there.
Goodnight Frankie 🌙❤️
Ice is still on the lake, you believe that? Middle of March.
Told you. Bea says the robins are lying to us.
Still on for opener? I'll bring the minnows.
Wouldn't miss it. I'll bring the coffee and the good thermos
Your outboard still running rough?
Cleaned the carb last night. Sounds better but I'll believe it when it's on the water
Good. Last year I was rowing home like a Viking
That was YOUR motor Dale
Details
Walleye were hitting off the point this morning. Got four keepers
You went without me??
Bea needed me out of the house. Painting the spare room
Fair enough. Save me a fillet
Come by Thursday, she's making her cabbage rolls too
Cabbage rolls AND fish. You're spoiling me
Saw your truck at the Midway lot. Stopped by the old shop?
Just dropping off a casserole dish for Walt. Place looks the same. Smells the same too. Cutting oil
Ha. Miss that smell and nothing else
My knees agree
Heads up, forecast says storms Saturday. Might push the trip
Fine by me. I'll put the boat cover on and find something to fix
You always find something
Mrs. Jablonski's snowblower. In June. Don't ask
Of course
Hitting the river early tomorrow. You in?
Can't this time. Next one.
Your loss. I'll bring the good bait.
Bea wants to know if you're eating enough. Her words
Tell her I'm eating like a king. Leftover pierogi for a week
She says that's not a vegetable
Tell her there's onion in it
You still up for Mille Lacs next month? I'm checking the walleye reports. They say the bite is good early morning
Always. Need to get the boat motor looked at first. It coughs on startup. I'll do it this week
You and your motors. I swear that thing has been rebuilt more times than my knee
It's better than new now. Machined the carb parts myself
Of course you did
Truck's making that rattle again. You still got your socket set?
Bring it by. Heat shield, I bet. Ten minutes.
Bea says you owe her a pierogi plate. She hasn't forgotten.
Tell her it's coming. Babcia's recipe takes time.
Bea is making her potato salad for the trip. She says she'll bring enough for ten people. It's the two of us
Tell her I'm not complaining. Leftovers are the best part
Did you see the Twins trade deadline mess. They traded away our best reliever for two guys nobody's heard of
I heard it on the radio this morning. I nearly spilled my coffee. Typical
They do it every year. Make us hope and then break our hearts
That's baseball. That's life too
Deep. Next you'll start writing poetry
Ha. Don't push it
Hey Frank you been scarce lately. Every time I call you're out. Bea thinks you've got a girlfriend
Tell Bea to mind her business, I'll tell you both everything when it's time. For now I'm just busy with things
So there IS something. I'll take that as a yes. Good for you buddy. We'll pry later over a bobber
I didn't say yes
You didn't say no either. 34 years I've known you, I can read you like a blueprint
Go fish somewhere
I'm going Thursday for the afternoon, small lake behind my cousin's place. Want to come, no pressure
Can't this time. Have to help someone with something. Rain check
Rain check granted. Caught four crappies, threw them back, felt like a poet
You got the poetry bug from me
Don't flatter yourself
Bea says to bring your good shirt to Mille Lacs, there's a fish fry at the resort. Dress up a little
The flannel IS my good shirt. I washed it
Wow, a miracle. Mark the calendar
Heard there's a thunderstorm tonight, you got your garage door closed? Last time the wind took the whole thing off your neighbor's
Walt's storm warning already reached me. Everything's tied down and put away
Good man. Gonna go watch the game tomorrow with the kids?
Going to my son's place tonight actually. He has the big TV. I'll miss the radio though, I like Dick Bremer's voice
Tell the boy to turn the volume down on the commercials
He'll do what he wants. Just like his father
Ha. See you in a couple weeks at the lake
Twins are a mess again. Bullpen blew it
Heard the whole thing on the radio. Nearly threw the radio
Frank it's Nancy from across the street. Is that you in the garage at 7 in the morning? Lol
Sorry Nancy, working on your mower like I said. Did the noise wake you
No I've been up since five. Old habits. Thank you!
Mower is ready. Fresh oil and a new plug. I'll roll it over
You're an angel. I made too much hotdish. Come by at 5
Tater tot?
Is there another kind
Thanks for the hotdish. Good to see you. Dish is clean and on your porch
Mail carrier left one of your packages at my door by mistake
Probably the filters I ordered for the furnace. Be right over
I'll leave it on the step, I'm heading to my sister's
Got it. Thanks Nancy
Planting tomatoes this week. You want a few seedlings? I started way too many
I'd take four. Romas if you have them
I have Romas and something called Brandywine
Two of each. I'll build a stake from scrap in the garage
Bringing them over now
My porch light burned out and the bulb is up too high for me
Don't climb anything. I'm coming with a stool and a bulb
You're too good to me
Fixed. It was the fixture, not the bulb. I swapped the socket
Frank, are you still doing the church rummage sale this year? We need a table captain
I'll captain the tools table. Nobody else knows a torque wrench from a pie server
Perfect. Bring a cash box?
Got one in the garage
Frank, I noticed you've been dressed up lately. New shirt? 👀
Just time to retire a flannel or two
Uh huh. And the cologne? I could smell it from the sidewalk
Nancy
Okay okay. I'm just happy for you. Whatever it is
Thanks. That's kind of you
We made over four hundred! Thank you for everything
Sold a vise grip to a nine-year-old. Future machinist
Ha! Recruiting from the cradle
Next year, bigger table
Block party planning meeting at my place, July. Just the street. Can you do the grill?
Sure. I'll bring the big one on wheels
The one that looks like a locomotive?
That's the one. Built it myself from a drum
Block party was great. Kids loved your sausage thing
Kielbasa. It's called kielbasa Nancy
Whatever it's called, send me the recipe
Garlic, marjoram, and patience
Your tomatoes are ripe by the way. I saw them from my window. Showoff
Taking a bag over now. Yours were the best seedlings
Keep an eye on my house next week? Visiting my sister for a few days
Of course. I'll grab the mail and water the ferns
Key is under the green frog. Thank you Frank
Frank! Rick Wozniak. Got two seats for the opener against Cleveland, you want one
Does a bear do it in the woods. Yes
Section 118. Right behind the dugout
Fancy. How much do I owe you
Get the first beer and we're even
Deal. I'll wear the lucky cap
The one with the sweat stain shaped like Wisconsin?
It's a Minnesota sweat stain. Show some respect
Great game. Don't care about the loss. Hot dogs were solid
Bullpen blew it in the eighth. Again. Seven years of the same thing
That's what makes us Minnesotans. Suffering
Frank, I'm trying to sell my table saw. Want it before I list it online?
What's wrong with it?
Nothing. Wife says I need the garage space
Ha. I'll take a look Saturday. Blade guard included?
Yes. And a spare blade
Bought it. $150 cash, fair?
Fair. Come get it
Works like new. Thanks Rick. Beer sometime
You see the lineup they posted today?
Saw it. Third baseman hitting ninth. What are they doing
No clue. We could manage better from the couch
I'm on the radio every night anyway. I yell at the speaker
My wife says I do the same. The dog hides
Remember when you tried to get me to join the fantasy league
Football one? Still open if you want it
I don't understand fantasy. I like real players on real grass
Fair enough. Old school
Thinking of buying a used pickup. Guy's asking 9,500 for a 2011 with 140k miles. Worth it?
Check the frame for rust and the transmission fluid color. If it smells burnt, walk
Will do. You want to come look? You know trucks better than I do
Sure. Text me the address
Frame is clean. Fluid's a little dark but not burnt. I'd offer 8,500
He took 8,700. Pickup is mine. Thanks Frank
Just don't haul anything crazy till you change the brake pads. They're thin
Noted. Hey, you in a mood for a day game next month? Got two more
I'm not sure on dates yet, let me check
Take your time. I'll hold them till the end of the week
I'm in. Count me in
Sweet. Pick you up at 11
New pickup is a champ. Hauled mulch today
Brake pads?
Scheduled for tomorrow. Yes dad
Good. I'd hate to scrape you off a bumper
Ha. That day game was a blast. We won!
First win I've seen in person all year. Maybe I'm the good luck charm
Or the cap
The cap. Definitely the cap
Trade deadline is getting close. They gonna sell or what
They always sell. It's tradition
Can't argue
Hey, my cousin is selling a snowblower. You know anything about Ariens?
Good brand. Check the shave plate and the auger belts
Will do. You're the encyclopedia
Watching the game at a buddy's place tonight? I heard you're free
Tonight I'm watching with family. Next time
Family, good. Say hi to your kids for me
Will do. Go Twins
Frank, you around today? Snowblower won't start again
Yeah I am. Bring it over to the garage. Probably the carb again.
Be there in ten
Bring the gas can too I am running low
Thanks for that. How much do I owe you
Nothing. You shoveled my walk twice last year
That was one time
Twice. I keep count
Cold enough for you?
Minus eleven this morning. My mustache froze to my coffee cup
Ha. Stay inside
Not a chance, got a lawnmower to look at for Nancy across the street
Did you see the plow come by? Left a wall at the end of my driveway
Yep. Same wall at mine. Was out there with the shovel at 7
You're a machine
Thirty four years of practice
Got a drip under the kitchen sink. You know anything about those
A little. Is it the trap or the supply line
No idea honestly
Put a bowl under it and I'll come by after lunch with my wrench
You're a lifesaver
It was the slip nut. Hand tight was not tight enough. Should be good now
Dry as a bone. Beer is on me
I'll take you up on that
City says street sweeping next week. Moving the cars
Thanks for the heads up, I forget every year
Tony, you still got that big ladder? Gutters are full of maple seeds
Sure thing. 28 foot extension. Come grab it
Tomorrow morning okay?
Garage is open, left side by the rakes
Ladder is back, thanks. Found a tennis ball up in the gutter, no idea
Haha that's from my dog three years ago
Grass is already knee high. Mower won't pull
Pull cord or the engine?
Cord. Just goes limp
Recoil spring probably. Bring it over
On my way
Done. New spring and I sharpened the blade, it was like a butter knife
Frank what would I do without you
Buy a new one every two years like everybody else
Memorial Day cookout at my place, you in? Brats and the game on
What time
Around 1
I'll bring the good sauerkraut from the Polish deli on Payne
Perfect. My brother in law is bringing a cooler the size of a casket
Thanks for having me. Brats were good. Your grill needs a new igniter btw
Ha. I just use a long match
That's how you lose eyebrows. I'll bring one by
Frank, my snowblower won't start. Winter's coming and I'm already scared
It's May Tony. Bring it over anyway, old gas turns to varnish
Bringing it now
Carb was gummed up. Cleaned it, new plug. Good for another ten winters
You're a lifesaver. Beer on me at the VFW
Deal. Wednesday?
Wednesday works
Great time last night. Your pierogi story still makes me laugh
Storm coming in tonight. Bring in the patio chairs
Already did. Thanks neighbor
You lose power over there? We're out
Yep. Flashlight and a transistor radio. Old school
There's a big branch down on your side of the alley
I see it. I'll get the chainsaw out after coffee
I'll help drag it. Give me 20
Fourth of July thing again at my place if you want. Fireworks are illegal but whatever
I'll see how the day goes. Might have plans
Plans? You? Who are you and what did you do with Frank
Very funny. Hose bib on the side of my house is leaking, you got a washer
Probably. Come by and dig through the coffee cans
Midway Hardware: Your special order is in - 1 carburetor repair kit (Briggs). Pick up at the counter any time. Hours M-F 7-6, Sat 8-4.
Thank you will stop by this afternoon
Midway Hardware: Spring sale starts Saturday! 20% off lawn and garden, free coffee while supplies last.
Your special order is in: 1/4 inch brass fittings, two-pack. Ready for pickup.
Be there this afternoon, thanks
Midway Hardware: Your order #48213 (trimmer head, 2 spark plugs) is ready for pickup.
Is the part for the weed whacker in? The one with the gear that stripped, I called yesterday
Midway Hardware: Hi Frank, yes, that part came in this morning with order #48213. See you soon!
Midway Hardware: Reply STOP to opt out. Summer clearance: grills, patio sets, fans. Ends Sunday.
Do you still carry the 5/16 flare nut wrenches? Seen them on the rack before
Midway Hardware: Yes sir, we have the set of 6 and singles in aisle 9. Want us to hold a set?
Hold one set please. I will be in after lunch
Midway Hardware: Held at the counter under Ostrowski. Thanks Frank!
Midway Hardware: Fall is coming! Snowblower tune-up kits and shear pins now in stock. Get them before the first flurry.
Frank, new kid on the Haas can't hold a tolerance to save his life. Wish you were here
Teach him to check his offsets. Twice. Then once more
I did. He nodded and then did it wrong
That's how it starts. I was the same at his age
You were worse
Frank it's Walt from down the alley. My chainsaw is smoking. Is that normal
Smoking from the engine or the bar? If it's the bar the chain is dull or you ran it dry of oil. Stop using it
Bar. Mostly
Bring it to the garage. And bring the chain oil you've been using
Oil? I've been using the oil that came in the can
That's motor oil for the tank. You need bar and chain oil. Different thing Walt. I'll explain when you get here
Thanks again. The saw runs like new. My wife made you a rhubarb pie, drop by and pick it up
Rhubarb pie!! I'm on my way. Don't let her give it to anyone else
Saving it. She said you looked thin last time. Bring a fork
Thin?? I'm built like a fire hydrant. But I'll take the pie
Do you know anyone who can haul away an old fridge? Garage is full of junk
Call Hal's Towing, he has a flatbed. Or the city has a pickup program, they take appliances if you call ahead. Tell them the freon was removed
Hal quoted me 75. City says three weeks wait. Ugh
Hal. Seventy five is fair. Don't wait three weeks, the fridge isn't getting any younger
Done. Garage has room for the new tools now
The new tools. Right. Walt, you're buying more tools you don't use
A man can never have enough wrenches
Agreed. That's actually true
Potluck at the church hall Saturday after next. Peg is making her hotdish. You in
I'll come if there's coffee. And I'll bring kielbasa and sauerkraut
Perfect, we'll have a polka fan club
My knees are too old for polka. I'll just tap my foot
Got the casserole dish back. Your sister's recipe?
Mine. Hotdish with tater tots. Don't tell anyone, they'll think I've gone soft
My wife wants the recipe
Tell her it's a secret. Then email it to her
My riding mower has a flat tire. Do you have a tube that fits
I have a patch kit and a couple old tubes. What size is the tire. Look on the side wall, there are numbers like 15x6.00-6
I'll bring over what I have and fix it right on your driveway. Don't try to do it yourself, you'll pinch the tube
You're the only reason this neighborhood still has green lawns
Flattery works. I'll be there at 3
Company picnic is next month. They asked if retirees are welcome
Free brats? I'm there
That's the spirit
Frank, noticed you've been leaving the house a lot in the evenings. Everything okay? Peg was worried. Not prying
All good Walt. Tell Peg thanks for worrying. I've just been getting out more. Doctor says it's good for my heart
Good to hear. That's all we wanted to know
Tell her I'll bring tomatoes over, got too many this year
Peg says she'll trade you a jar of her dill pickles
Now that's a fair deal
Good to see you today. You look good. Rested
Retirement agrees with me. Come fishing sometime
I get seasick in a bathtub. But maybe the dock
Storm is coming tonight, heavy wind. Put your lawn chairs away
Already did. Thanks for the heads up Walt
Frank hi, it's Carol from St. Casimir's parish bake sale committee. We are short on volunteers for the fall pierogi sale
Hello Carol. Which weekend
October. We need hands for pinching dough. Your pierogi were the talk of the last potluck
I can do the Friday prep in the church kitchen. Send me the time
Wonderful. Will do. Do you have a recipe you can share with the committee?
The recipe is old and in my head. I will show you how at the prep day. Potato and farmer cheese and a lot of butter
Perfect, thank you!!
Reminder Frank: Lenten fish fry this Friday, volunteers arrive at 4 PM. We need you on the fryer
Fryer duty again. I will be there at 4. Please keep the youngsters away from the oil
Last year's burned thumb club says amen
We served 212 dinners last night!! Thank you for frying all of it

Told the kids I sold it in '17. Couldn't. It's at the credit union with the house deed and Pop's medals. Key on the blue lanyard.

Check lanyard is still on the nail by the back door.

notes.title: Babcia's pierogi
notes.body:
Dough: 3 cups flour, 1 egg, 1 cup warm water, pinch of salt, spoon of sour cream.
Filling: potato, farmer cheese, fried onion, lots of pepper.
Roll thin. Use the water glass for cutting circles.
Boil till they float, then fry in butter.
Never let Tommy near the dough, he overworks it.
